plan_title: Fixes from run r20261006-162245 — export honesty, result-aware liveness, run phase lines, own-group surprises, the live-tier guard, and two plan-check seeds
plan_objective:
Close the tool-side backlog that driving infinity-skills run r20261006-162245
left behind (`.orchestrator/notes-driver-findings-r20261006-162245.md`,
items 3–7) plus the two seeds the previous smart_mcps run left open (S1, S2
in `.orchestrator/notes-r20261006-115802.md`), on the branch that already
carries the two mid-run fixes (`fix/stream-result-grace-close`, PR #19).
Every unit is a defect with a regression test, or a guard against the class
of defect that cost the most driver time:

- `export` wrote metadata-only bundles with exit 0 and "wrote <dir>" when the
  raw transcripts were gone, and re-exporting into an existing `--out` left
  stale `events/*.jsonl.gz` behind — one wasted hour-long rebuild.
- The liveness probe read an idle child's 0.6% CPU as "cpu advancing" for 94
  minutes after its `result` event, so no `not live` line ever came.
- A `run` recipe's per-command phases live only in heartbeat labels and
  `attempt-*/n.result.json`; a plan item that greps `run.log` for
  `command N/6` cannot pass.
- A surprise naming only its own group is bucketed `__run__` and reported at
  `finish` as "unknown group id".
- Nothing runs the worker-seam live tests before a run; wedge 2 (data_dirs
  not a read root) was exactly a live-coverage gap.
- S1: a `Run (driver):` item naming a test that does not exist passes the
  gate and the merge; the driver finds out after the run.
- S2: a unit whose Goal says a symbol changes while the symbol's file is not
  in its Files groups wrong and surprises the wrong group; `plan-check` says
  nothing.

Not in scope (decided 2026-10-07): checking a `Run:` line's flags against the
program's `--help` (the `--db` case), the token undercount from r20260927, a
`data_dirs` path lint (moot after 815b118), and the optimize KPI loop.

units.summary: `plan-check` gains a zero-codegraph lint that reads every unit's Goal for a backticked identifier used as the subject of a change verb ("X gains", "X becomes", "X now prints"), finds that symbol's `def`/`class` definition by scanning the repo's tracked Python files, and warns "U<N>: Goal changes X, defined in <file>, which is not in its Files" when none of the defining files is listed — so a unit that will edit a file without listing it is flagged before grouping.
units.goal: new function `lint_goal_symbols(plan_text: str, repo_root: Path) -> list[str]` in `orchestrator/grouping/verification_lint.py`: per unit (`_safe_split_units`, bullets via `_split_bullets` from `plan_sections.py`), find in the `Goal` text every backticked span whose entire content matches `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*(\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)*` (a path, a flag or a call with parentheses never qualifies) and that is immediately followed (after the closing backtick and whitespace, with an optional possessive `'s`) by a change verb from one module-level constant `_CHANGE_VERBS` (`gains`, `becomes`, `now`, `no longer`, `extends`, `accepts`, `emits`, `prints`, `logs`, `raises`, `returns`, `refuses`, `drops`, `writes`, `reads`, `stops`, `is`, `are`); take the first and last dotted segment as candidate names (skip names shorter than 4 characters and Python keywords). Build one definitions index per call from `git -C <repo> ls-files -z -- '*.py'` (fallback: `rglob('*.py')` excluding `.venv`, `.worktrees`, `node_modules`, `.git`) by matching `^\s*(?:async\s+def|def|class)\s+(\w+)\b`. A candidate with at least one defining file, none of which is in the unit's task-map `files` (and no file in `files` defining it), yields one warning per (unit, symbol) naming the symbol, the defining file(s) and the verb that made it a change. A symbol defined nowhere is prospective and silent; a token that is only mentioned (no change verb after it) is silent — the lint reads subject-verb, never every mention. `_cmd_plan_check` (cli.py) prints these with the existing warnings (exit 0).
